Use this checklist before every field session to ensure you are prepared, safe, and ready to participate fully in field activities.

## The Night Before

- Check the weather forecast
- Lay out field clothes and footwear
- Fill your water bottle
- Charge your phone
- Pack your daily field gear
- Make sure your field notebook and binoculars are packed
- Double-check your alarm; set multiple alarms if necessary

## Before You Leave

- Eat breakfast
- Check your email for last-minute schedule changes
- Bring your daily field gear

## Required Daily Field Gear

### Observation Equipment

- Binoculars
- Field guide
- Smartphone with:
  - Merlin installed
  - eBird installed
  - Charged battery
- Portable battery pack (recommended)

### Data Recording

- Field notebook
- Pencil
- Backup pencil

### Clothing and Personal Gear

- Long pants
- Field footwear or rubber boots
- Jacket or additional layers
- Hat
- Water bottle
- Snacks or lunch
- Sunscreen
- Insect repellent
- Daypack or backpack

## Equipment the Instructor Will Bring

- Spotting scope
- Additional field guides
- Rubber boots or waders
- Sampling equipment
- First aid supplies

Students are not expected to purchase specialized ornithology equipment beyond the required personal field gear listed above.

## Field Expectations

- Arrive on time and prepared
- Stay with the group
- Respect wildlife, habitats, and private property
- Record observations in your field notebook
- Be prepared for changing weather conditions
- Participate actively and ask questions
